title: Poultry Sheds in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel poultry sheds with insulated roofs, ventilation and long clear spans for broiler and layer farms in Pakistan.
h1: Poultry Sheds in Pakistan: Steel Houses With Controlled Air and Temperature
quickAnswer: A poultry shed must hold a stable temperature and give steady ventilation. Steel Mind Engineers designs long, narrow steel houses with insulated roofs and frames that carry hanging equipment.
alt: Row of steel poultry sheds with insulated roofs on a farm in Pakistan.

faq.q: What roof is best for poultry sheds?
faq.a: Insulated roof panels are best because they keep the inside cooler.

faq.q: Can the frame carry fans and feeding lines?
faq.a: Yes. Tell the engineer about the equipment so the frame is designed for its weight.

blocks.text: Birds are sensitive to heat, damp and bad air. The shed must hold a stable temperature and give steady ventilation. The steel structure must also carry the weight of equipment hung from the roof, such as feeders, drinkers, fans and cooling pads.

Insulated panels reduce heat gain in summer and heat loss in winter. Fan openings and inlets are placed in the frame design from the start. The frames are checked for equipment loads on the roof members. Poultry houses are long and narrow, and steel frames with regular bays suit this shape. Smooth surfaces and good drainage help cleaning between batches.
Steel sheds are fast to build, so you can start production sooner. They resist rot and pests, and they can be extended when you add a new house.
